title: Netting Order Discounts Off the Spend Circle Points Are Earned On
content:
Discounts credited on a profile's orders under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment are taken off the
merchandise lines counted before any rate is applied when reward points on a Northbeam Circle Membership are
worked out, and one credit is taken off rather than two.

## The readings

1. Where a promotional discount was credited inside the window the lines are counted over, the spend is the
   lines counted less that promotional discount.
2. Where no promotional discount was credited inside that window and a price match was credited inside it, the
   spend is the lines counted less that price match.
3. Where neither of those holds, the spend is the lines counted as they stand.

## Only one credit is netted off

The second reading turns on no promotional discount having been credited inside the window, so a profile
carrying both kinds of credit inside that window has the promotional discount taken off and the price match
left where it stands. Both credits are read over the same window the merchandise lines are counted over, not
over a window of their own.

## Hypothetical figures

| Lines counted | Promotional discount credited in the window | Price match credited in the window | The spend |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1600.00 | 210.00 | Nothing | 1390.00 |
| 1600.00 | 210.00 | 95.00 | 1390.00 |
| 1600.00 | Nothing | 95.00 | 1505.00 |
| 1600.00 | Nothing | Nothing | 1600.00 |

Both credits are counted as the credits standing on the profile's orders inside that window, not as the
credits on any single order.
